definition_zh: 评估员；估价员；评税员；（法庭）陪审顾问
definition_en: an official who calculates the value or quality of something, especially property or taxes
core_image: 手持登记簿逐户为房产定价的市政人员
scene: 市政厅里，评估员对照图纸为每栋临街商铺核定税基。The county assessor valued the farmhouse at twice its asking price.
sceneCN: 这里 assessor 是「估价员、评税员」（第 1 个义项：核定价值的官员）；句意是县估价员把这栋农舍估为要价的两倍。

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「评估；核定」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「评估；核定税额」
由动词加后缀构成，义为「可评估的；应征税的」

senses.title: An official valuer
senses.definition: an official who determines the value of property for taxation
senses.definitionCN: 为征税而核定财产价值的官员
senses.example: The assessor's list raised taxes across the district.
senses.exampleCN: 估价员的清单提高了全区的税额。
senses.why: Latin assidere means to sit beside; the Roman assessor literally sat beside the magistrate to help fix amounts.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 assidere 意为坐在旁边；罗马的 assessor 字面上就坐在官员旁协助定夺。

senses.title: An expert evaluator
senses.definition: a person who judges quality, skill, or damage, as in exams or insurance
senses.definitionCN: 在考试、保险等场合评判质量、技能或损失的人
senses.example: Independent assessors reviewed the damaged warehouses.
senses.exampleCN: 独立评估人核查了受损的仓库。
senses.why: Sitting beside a case remains the image: the evaluator views it close at hand.
senses.whyCN: 「坐于一旁」仍是意象：评估者在近旁审视案情。

intro.en: Assessor is the agent noun of assess, from Latin assidere, to sit beside, from ad- plus sedere, to sit.
intro.cn: assessor 是 assess 的施动者名词，assess 源自拉丁语 assidere（坐在旁边），由 ad- 加 sedere（坐）构成。

items.en: Sedere meant to sit; assidere meant to sit beside.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sedere 意为坐；assidere 意为坐在旁边。

items.en: The Roman assessor sat beside officials to help set fees and fines.
items.cn: 罗马的 assessor 坐在官员旁协助定税与罚金。

items.en: Assesser meant to fix a tax.
items.cn: 古法语 assesser 意为核定税额。

items.en: English formed assessor for tax officials and, later, examiners.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语用 assessor 指税官，后亦指考官。

note.en: An assessor does not only judge: the root job is fixing amounts, especially for tax.
note.cn: assessor 不只作评判：其本源职责是核定数额，尤指税额。

entries.definition: to estimate value or impose a charge
the act or result of assessing
liable to be assessed or taxed
a sitting of a court or group, from sedere
one who estimates value, especially for sale
one who judges worth or quality

normalIntro.en: Hear assess + or: the one who assesses sits beside the numbers.
normalIntro.cn: assess（评估）+ or（人）：坐在账册旁核定数额的人，即 assessor。

normal.en: assidere: to sit beside the magistrate.
the assessor helps fix fees and taxes.
session, sedentary share the sitting root.
in Britain, assessors also aid judges.
normal.cn: 在英国，assessor 亦协助法官。

normal.en: assess adds tax sense to evaluate.
normal.cn: assess 在「评估」外另有「征税」义。

abstract.en: Picture a stool set beside a magistrate's bench.
abstract.cn: 想象官员席旁摆着的一张小凳。

abstract.en: See a ledger open, one line at a time priced.
abstract.cn: 看见账本翻开，逐行标价。

abstract.en: Feel the weight of an official's careful glance.
abstract.cn: 体会官员审慎目光的分量。

examples.en: The assessor reinspected the flooded shop.
examples.cn: 评估员复查了被水淹的店铺。

examples.en: Homeowners argued with the assessor over square footage.
examples.cn: 业主就建筑面积与估价员争辩。

examples.en: Exam assessors met to align their standards.
examples.cn: 考官们开会统一评分标准。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额赛瑟」——额坐在赛场旁打分定税，正是 assessor 的评估职责。

root: 拉丁语 ad-（朝向）+ sedere（坐）→ assidere「坐在旁侧协助核定」，施动名词 assessor 即「核定人」。

sensesIntro.en: Sitting beside authority becomes valuing property and judging quality.
sensesIntro.cn: 「坐在权威之侧」演化为核定财产价值与评判质量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clerk seated beside the bench, pricing the world line by line
core.cn: 核心意象：坐在席位旁的书记员逐行给世界标价

branches.cn: 评判理赔或作业的专家

branches.en: numbers set by a seated expert
branches.cn: 由坐席专家核定的数字

branches.en: the tax link of the office
quality review in exams and claims
branches.cn: 考试与理赔中的质量审查

intro.en: The sedere family gathers English words about sitting and sessions.
intro.cn: sedere 词族汇集英语中关于坐与集会的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin sedere is the seat of a wide word family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 sedere 是一个庞大词族的「座位」。

items.meaning: a covered seat carried, later a car
items.meaningCN: 轿子；轿车（词源或与「坐」相关）
